class.name: EntityScene
class.brief_description: A native 3D entity document or prefab.
class.description: Stores a persistent entity catalog and addressable records in the native [code].escn[/code] format. Loading the resource reads its catalog; native document operations explicitly load component subsets into Flecs. Resident components belong to that world. Shared mesh, material, and texture assets retain ResourceUID references. This format does not load legacy Node scenes. Native editor commands use persistent document, entity, component, and field identities. A separate document and world are used for play.

method.name: get_document_id
method.description: Returns the persistent 128-bit document identity as hexadecimal text.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the latest native record diagnostic, including entity and field addresses when available.

method.name: get_record_count
method.description: Returns the catalog size, including unloaded records and deletion tombstones.

method.name: get_resident_count
method.description: Returns the number of entities materialized in this document's native world.
